stem: Which number line best models the expression 3 ÷ \( \frac{1}{3} \)?

options.label: A
options.text: Number line labeled 0 to 9 with 27 short jumps, each of length \( \frac{1}{3} \), from 0 to 9.

options.label: B
options.text: Number line labeled 0 to 3 with 9 jumps, each of length \( \frac{1}{3} \), from 0 to 3.

options.label: C
options.text: Number line labeled 0 to 9 with 3 jumps, each of length 3, from 0 to 9.

options.label: D
options.text: Number line labeled 0 to 3 with 3 jumps, each of length 1, from 0 to 3.

visual_elements: Four number lines with labeled points and distinct arcs representing jumps corresponding to answer choices A, B, C, and D.
